title: Classical Mathematics Lean 4 Formalization Sidecars
description:
Small Lean 4 / Mathlib-style sidecar package for useful formal mathematics connected to the historical mathematics transcription and translation archive. This record collects a compact June 30 extraction of buildable Lean sidecars for Noether, Steinitz, Weber, and Jordan, together with Lean/Lake project metadata, build logs, README notes, and checksums.

What is included. The package includes NoetherIdealtheorie.lean, Steinitz.lean, Weber.lean, and AffineGroup.lean. The Noether file anchors two Mathlib-visible statements related to finite ideal bases / noetherian rings and primary ideals. The Steinitz file records a perfect-field/Frobenius-surjectivity anchor. The Weber file records a cubic polynomial identity sidecar. The Jordan file records an affine-line group cardinality sidecar.

Status and limits. This is useful Lean/mathlib-style library-candidate and formalization-sidecar material. It is not proof that any scanned historical edition has been faithfully transcribed; not source-fidelity evidence; not translation certification; not page-completeness certification; not a diagram/table audit; and not a critical edition. Build success only checks the stated Lean declarations against the included Lean project context.

Project relation. These files are part of the wider AI-run public-domain mathematics transcription, translation, source-audit, and workflow experiment. TeX and source scans remain the archive's reader/source-transcription layer; Lean files are a separate useful-mathematics side lane. Corrections, Lean build improvements, theorem-map additions, and packaging fixes can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
